<subject>Re: Tatjana Indication</subject>
<body>
Klaus-Günter,  
If you were to assess this from a NordBasis Nordsee index perspective, how would it appear? I believe he intends to float against an indexed price but wants a sense of the typical basis adjustment to Nordsee we’d apply. It’s not a binding offer—more of a market signal, given no actual transaction is imminent. The tighter our indication aligns with Nordsee, the stronger our positioning. We should provide a robust indicative level, subject to credit approval. When it comes to finalising, he’ll likely hold off—units lack operational history—so the eventual market rate remains uncertain.  

Arno  
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----  
From: Paffrath, Klaus-Günter  
Sent: Mittwoch, 18. Juni 2025 09:32  
To: Hertrampf, Arno  
Cc: Reising, Lorenzo; Johann, Fritz  
Subject: Tatjana Indication  

Arno, here are the quarterly indications for Tatjana that we discussed:  

		Q301			Q401			Q102			Q202  

HLH		120			65			50			49  

LLH		57			38			30			28  

The prices indicated are for firm power delivered with liquidated damages. Unit contingent products will be discounted 20%-30% on HLH and 10%-20% on LLH depending on term.  
</quoted>
